thread:
incident-bot: Pager: prod-canary: elevated crashloop rate on encoder-service canary -> paging maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): Seeing 5/6 canary pods CrashLoopBackOff after the configmap rollout at ~4310005600. Frontend errors spiking for /v1/generate.

tracy (support): Customer tickets start coming in, few timeouts and 503s. Not widespread yet but noticeable for a couple of enterprise tenants.

sam (eng-runtime): Any recent changes to encoder resource limits or affinity?

maria (oncall): Yes, configmap "encoder-config" was updated in the rollout: memoryLimit set to "1Gi" (used to be 6Gi) and nodeAffinity changed to prefer gpu=true nodes. possible cause.

lee (sre): HPA reacted, scaled replicas down then back up, which caused churn. Logs show OOMKilled on container start: "OOMKilled" and "failed to allocate kv-cache".

maria (oncall): I'm going to divert traffic off the canary. Applying emergency toggle to stop encoder_v2 canary traffic.

sam (eng-runtime): Good. Also prepare a rollback plan: if toggle not enough, rollback the deployment to previous ReplicaSet.

maria (oncall): Applied feature toggle: encoder_v2_route=off :white_check_mark: Traffic for canary should be redirected to stable immediately. Monitoring...

devops-bot: Action executed: feature-toggle encoder_v2_route -> false (by maria). Incident note created: #INC-4310005678.

tracy (support): I told impacted customers we have a mitigation in place and we're investigating root cause.

lee (sre): Toggle reduced frontend error rate but canary pods still CrashLoopBackOff. Need to roll back the bad pod template. Will attempt rollout undo.

sam (eng-runtime): Be careful: rolling undo may try to create old pods, but HPA/minReplicas set to 0 in the bad HPA patch? I see hpa.minReplicas=0 for that namespace, that could let RC drop to zero.

maria (oncall): Running: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/encoder-service --to-revision=4

sam (eng-runtime): Output: "deployment.apps/encoder-service undone to revision 4". New ReplicaSet created but pods are pending. Check events.

lee (sre): Events show scheduling failures: "0/5 nodes available: 3 node(s) had taint gpu-only, 2 node(s) Insufficient memory." The affinity change prevented scheduling on older nodes and memory limit is too low to start containers.

maria (oncall): I'll patch the configmap back to the previous values (memoryLimit 6Gi) to let pods start. Running: kubectl -n prod set env daemonset/encoder-config --from=configmap/encoder-config-old (manual patch).

sam (eng-runtime): Suggest direct patch: kubectl -n prod patch configmap encoder-config -p '{"data":{"memoryLimit":"6Gi","nodeAffinity":""}}' and then rollout restart deployment/encoder-service. That will let scheduler place pods.

maria (oncall): Patch applied and restarted deployment. Pods are creating.

devops-bot: Noted: configmap encoder-config reverted (by maria). Restart triggered.

lee (sre): One pod still failing with mount errors: "failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to set up network for sandbox". Looks like a transient CNI flake on node-12.

maria (oncall): cordon node-12 and drain to isolate. kubectl cordon node-12 && kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30

sam (eng-runtime): Drain failed: PodDisruptionBudget prevents eviction for encoder-worker-5 (pdb minAvailable=3). If we evict we'll drop below minAvailable. Need temporary pdb relax.

maria (oncall): I'm going to scale down the pdb temporarily: kubectl patch pdb encoder-pdb -p '{"spec":{"minAvailable":1}}'

lee (sre): PDB patched. Drain resumed. Node-12 drained, cordoned. New pods scheduled on healthy nodes and are coming up.

tracy (support): Error rate back to baseline. Customers notified that hotfix applied and service restored.

sam (eng-runtime): Root cause summary for postmortem: bad rollout included two failures: 1) configmap set memoryLimit too low (1Gi) causing OOM at startup, 2) nodeAffinity change restricted scheduling to gpu-only nodes causing pods to land on nodes with insufficient memory and a node with transient CNI failure. HPA minReplicas=0 change exacerbated churn.

maria (oncall): Actions: revert config policy to validate memoryLimits, CI gate for affinity changes, prevent HPA minReplicas=0 in prod. Will open tickets.

devops-bot: Follow-up tasks created: TICKET-43101 (config validation), TICKET-43102 (affinity CI check), TICKET-43103 (HPA policy).

sam (eng-runtime): Thanks team. I'll own postmortem write-up and schedule oncall handoff doc update.

maria (oncall): Handing off to sam for next shift. Leaving notes in Incident doc. :white_check_mark:

lee (sre): Closing pager, monitoring for 30m.

tracy (support): I'll update customers with the detailed timeline once postmortem is ready.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: prod-canary incident cleared at 4310006023.
